steps.title: Identify and Audit Demo Lock References
steps.description: Locate all 15-minute demo lock timer invocations and overlay dialog displays across activity classes.

steps.title: Neutralize Demo Lock Manager Class
steps.description: Disable the timer, overlay dialog, and expiry check logic inside DemoLockManager so the app remains permanently unlocked.

steps.title: Remove Lock Checks from Main Activity
steps.description: Strip out DemoLockManager calls from MainActivity lifecycle methods.

steps.title: Update Add and Edit Mobile Activity
steps.description: Remove demo lock checks from AddEditMobileActivity.

steps.title: Clean Up Stock In Activity
steps.description: Remove lock timer handlers and expiry checks from StockInActivity.

steps.title: Update Stock Out Activity
steps.description: Remove demo lock enforcement from StockOutActivity.

steps.title: Clean Up All Mobiles Activity
steps.description: Remove lock manager hooks from AllMobilesActivity.

steps.title: Update Camera Scanner Activity
steps.description: Remove lock enforcement from CameraScanActivity to allow continuous scanning.

steps.title: Clean Up Result and Audit Log Activities
steps.description: Remove lock references from ResultActivity and HistoryActivity.

steps.title: Building Bhagwati Stock
steps.description: Assemble debug APK with demo lock restriction fully removed.
